rationale: Six genuinely distinct record-level measurements were source-replayed and qualified without labels. Test conditional contribution, rather than reopening the failed32-group nonlinear-head search.
cohort: Original80patients/7635channels/256seizures; each original fold's FIT only. Reuse20 exact inner selection TRAIN/CAL/CHOICE/(HELD) partitions and20 inner-cross-fitted frozen Raw192 representations. No original Development or Outer artifacts read.

contexts.PHYS: No baseline coordinates: new groups only; empty subset is intercept-only
contexts.PHYS_OLD7: Original seven groups14coordinates plus optional new groups
contexts.RAW: Frozen Raw192 plus optional new groups
contexts.RAW_OLD7: Frozen Raw192 and original14 physiology coordinates plus optional new groups

preprocessing: Use exactly qualified float64 exact-constant-safe patient-relative normalization for BOTH old14 and new12 physiology coordinates, separately per whole unlabeled patient. Raw192 is unchanged. Refit finite TRAIN-only mean imputation and population mean/SD (SD0->1) on each selection TRAIN, then on TRAIN+CHOICE for assessed heads. No epsilon floor or clipping. Historical legacy-floor heads are not direct paired comparators.
eligibility: Repeat all source/coverage/variation gates within the own selection TRAIN only. Source finite and eligible baseline rates>=.99; both summary-coordinate coverages>=.99 except legitimately censored crossing positions; rate coordinate still>=.99. At least one coordinate nonconstant in>=.5 of TRAIN patients using64 float32 eps relative-range rule. No identity exclusions. Exact duplicate new groups in TRAIN: retain lower index, report reason. Global source coverage is descriptive only.
head: Full dense sklearn Ridge(alpha=1, fit_intercept=True, solver=cholesky), float64, target2EZ-1; original patient-equal inverse-global-class weights normalized to mean1; sigmoid score mapped to EZ probability. Empty PHYS uses weighted target-mean intercept. No head hyperparameter search or approximate block solver.
threshold: Original CAL-only EZ probability grid0to1 by.005; maximize patient MacroF1, then EZF1, then closeness to.5, then lower threshold. Exact pinned original probes.py implementation.
selection: Exhaust all eligible new-group subsets, at most64 per context/path. Choice score equals mean of patient AUROC/AP/MacroF1/EZF1 minus.1 times sample SD of the same utility across represented CHOICE sources (0 if one source). Choose smallest k within.005 of overall maximum; within that k choose highest score then lexicographically smallest group tuple. No HELD labels or pooled assessment outcomes in this choice.
assessment: Freeze all80 context/path choices before any HELD predictions. For15 assessment paths, refit heads on TRAIN+CHOICE, retain CAL for threshold, seal HELD probabilities before a separate evaluator loads HELD labels. Arms: BASE, SELECTED, BEST_ALTERNATIVE at selected k, RANDOM_A, RANDOM_B, ALL_ELIGIBLE, and best CHOICE subset at each k0..6. Cache duplicate masks as aliases, never count aliases as extra actual fits. BEST_ALTERNATIVE is chosen using CHOICE, not HELD. Random draws depend only on seed42, fold, screen, k and eligible indices.
final_paths: Five screen0 paths have no HELD and contribute final fold-specific selection/stability only; do not use the fifteen assessment scores to select their k.
budget: At most5120 search fits (4contexts x20paths x64), at most720 distinct assessment refits (4contexts x15paths x12 masks), zero new encoders, M8 or Outer runs. Independent replay fits are verification, separately counted. No bootstrap feature re-search in this registration.
reporting: Patientmacro primary over repeated fold/patient appearances, secondary unique-identity-equal. Publish all contexts/arms, fold and source strata, k-curves, selection frequencies and pairwise Jaccard for15 assessment choices and5 final choices.10000 seed42 paired patient-ID cluster draws carry all repeated appearances together. Six clinical/ranking primary endpoints receive simultaneous max-standardized bootstrap sensitivity, clearly exploratory. No best-context presentation or selected successful endpoint.
allocation_gate: New-measurement screening gate only: RAW_OLD7 SELECTED-BASE four-endpoint utility95% patient-cluster interval lower>0; all four primary clinical deltas>0; all four known-source AUROC deltas>=-.02; final5 selected-set mean Jaccard>=.5, with at least4nonempty sets. Passing only warrants separately registered matched nonlinear confirmation of this new family. It does not pass the old32-group failed readout gate, authorize full M8/Outer, prove global minimality, or establish clinical gain. Failure stops expansion of this six-group screen.
adaptivity: This entire internal cohort and historical Outer have been repeatedly viewed in prior studies. Legal within-run patient isolation does not make this a fresh independent confirmation. Do not tune this protocol after outcomes or claim confirmatory intervals.
execution: Stable CPU environment, OMP/MKL/OPENBLAS threads1, no unrelated jobs changed. Preserve all sources, failed gates and prior artifacts. Resume only exact hash-bound completed cells after engineering diagnosis, new log names. No installed extraction skill.
privacy: Publish source, protocol and anonymous aggregates only. Trusted serialized containers may be materialized during preparation; only own-FIT labels are indexed, HELD labels are omitted from selector inputs. No patient IDs, per-channel scores, weights, scalers, embeddings or runtime logs uploaded.
